now.title: WandaVision
now.text: In episode 7, Wanda gives birth to twins in Westview, and Billy finds he can hear other people's thoughts.

proposed.text: In episode 3, Wanda gives birth to twins in Westview. Billy, the younger, later finds he can sense other people's thoughts.

changes.evidence: The twins are born in WandaVision episode 3 (WV103, 'Now in Color'); Billy's mind-reading first shows in episode 6 (sensing Vision in distress) and episode 7 (he cannot hear Agnes's thoughts). The record labels the birth as episode 7.

now.title: Loki S2
now.text: In episode 4, Casey tracks Renslayer's TemPad and stands with Loki's friends as the Temporal Loom explodes.
cases: ST-110 The Failure of the Temporal Loom (Loki S2)

proposed.text: In episode 4, Casey helps Ouroboros and Victor Timely build the Throughput Multiplier, then watches in horror as the Temporal Loom explodes.

changes.evidence: Casey tracks Renslayer's TemPad in Loki S2 episode 2 ('Breaking Brad', LK202), not episode 4. In episode 4 ('Heart of the TVA', LK204) he works with Ouroboros and Timely on the Throughput Multiplier and watches the Loom explode.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
now.text: In episode 5, Ayo comes for Zemo, clashes with Bucky, and later takes Zemo to the Raft.

proposed.text: In episode 5, tipped off by Bucky, Ayo arrests Zemo at the Sokovian memorial and takes him to the Raft.

changes.evidence: Ayo's clash with Bucky (removing his vibranium arm) happens in FATWS episode 4 in Riga (TFaTWS104). In episode 5 ('Truth', TFaTWS105) Bucky tips her off, she arrests Zemo in Sokovia and says the Dora Milaje will take him to the Raft; there is no fight with Bucky.

proposed.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
proposed.text: In episode 4, Ayo comes for Zemo in Riga, fights John Walker, and removes Bucky's metal arm when he steps in.

changes.evidence: In FATWS episode 4 ('The Whole World Is Watching', TFaTWS104) the Dora Milaje arrive in Riga for Zemo; Ayo fights Walker and Battlestar and removes Bucky's vibranium arm. This is the clash currently misplaced in the episode 5 record.
